system.description:
Hooking and grasping arches of hardened sand stone sprout from the ground in a 20-foot cube starting from a point within range. For the duration, these earthen arches turn the ground into difficult terrain. Creatures cannot take the dash or dodge actions while within this area of difficult terrain.

Creature(s) of your choice in the area when this jutsu is cast must make a Strength saving throw, being Restrained on a failed save until the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, select one creature who failed their saving throw, they become Restrained for the duration by sand that covers their entire body. They also take 2d8 earth damage at the beginning of each of their turns. A Restrained creature can make a Strength saving throw to end the Restrained condition at the end of each of their turns.

If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, As a bonus action you can select one Restrained creature and collapse the sand holding them, dealing 6d8 earth damage. If you do, this jutsu immediately ends on them.

If this jutsu is cast at A Rank or higher, all creatures who failed their saving throw are Restrained and at the beginning of their turns also takes 2d8 Chakra damage. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, when you spend your bonus action to collapse the sand, it affects all Restrained creatures.
